prereq_off.what: curriculum order: mul no longer waits for mac, nor reduce for modB

mac_n.what: mac posed as x d + N instead of A + x d (the multiply's accumulating row is no longer a problem of its own)

no_twins.what: no register twins (no task posed with X and Y swapped)

no_routines.what: routines off (solved tasks never become T.<task>); the round composes the merges

occam_steps_off.what: search rule: Occam's ties to the first found, not the fewest executed steps

skip_twins_off.what: search rule: twins searched again even when their original is solved

no_late.what: late table lessons never join (sub.inverse, identity, commute, the facts' borrows, the wrap fact, zero_minus)

no_redstep.what: law library: red.step's two practice problems dropped (modB, the chain; step)

no_step.what: law library: the step practice problem dropped

no_modB.what: law library: the chain practice problem (modB) dropped

no_mrow.what: law library: the multiply row practice problem (mrow) dropped

no_brg.what: instruction set: BRG.X out of every search

no_sel.what: instruction set: SEL.S out of every search

ans_smallest_t.what: the round's answers: the batch's smallest-T rows, no T = 1 filter

round_cost4.what: the round's search space: cost <= 4 instead of 5
